paragraphs: Rabbi Zeira told Rabbi Yoshiyah three things in the name of Jerusalem’s people. Yoshiyah related them to Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira, who agreed with him on two:Sifrei, Ki Tetze, on “If a man has a rebellious son”; Jerusalem Talmud; Sotah 25a, “I presented it to my colleagues in the south.” Rashi explains that Zeira was among Jerusalem’s people. Thus this Rabbi Zeira was early.
